QuestInfo.name: First Evan Launch Gift from the Admin
QuestInfo.0: The Maple Admin has prepared a gift for you to celebrate the launch of Evan. If you're curious about the gift, talk to the Maple Admin.
QuestInfo.1: The Maple Admin has prepared 5 different cash items that look especially good on Evan. You can get the first item from the Maple Admin when you reach Lv. 17.
QuestInfo.2: You have received your first Evan Launch Gift from the Admin.

0.0: Hello, Evan! I love to deliver good news! So I'm thrilled to tell you that I'm handing out special gifts to celebrate the launch of Evan. Are you interested?

yes.0: You must be super curious, hehe. I've prepared a little something for those who are diligently playing Evan.
yes.1: I am giving away 5 different pieces of Evan gear to Evans that are between Lv. 17 and 21. When you equip all five Evan cash items, you'll get a special effect! Talk to me once you're Lv. 17 and ready to collect your first gift!

no.0: It's a special gift that will be given out only until May 4th, so hurry over if you want it!
